# Input: '=' + 'a'*32762 + \"'''\" (multiline string at the very end, never closed)
data = bytearray(b'=')
data += b'a' * (32768 - 1 - 3)
data += b\"'''\"
assert len(data) == 32768
with open('/workspace/poc3.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
print('PoC3 written, size:', len(data))
print('Last 10 bytes:', data[-10:])
"
